dimensions.label: Time
dimensions.description: Temporal information such as dates, years, periods, sequences, or durations.

dimensions.label: Space
dimensions.description: Geographical or spatial information such as country, region, coordinates, or place.

dimensions.label: Activity
dimensions.description: Events, actions, processes, agreement types, or activities represented in the visualisation.

dimensions.label: Actor
dimensions.description: People, organisations, groups, signatories, participants, or stakeholders.

dimensions.label: Relational data
dimensions.description: Relationships or connections between entities, such as networks or links.

contributor_roles.label: Designer/Developer
contributor_roles.description: Person responsible for visual design, layout, interaction design, visual encoding decisions, or technical implementation.

contributor_roles.label: Domain researcher
contributor_roles.description: Person contributing subject expertise, research framing, or interpretation.

contributor_roles.label: Data curator
contributor_roles.description: Person responsible for preparing, cleaning, transforming, or managing data.

contributor_roles.label: Project lead
contributor_roles.description: Person responsible for coordinating the project.

contributor_roles.label: Advisor
contributor_roles.description: Person providing feedback or advisory input.

contributor_roles.label: Research partner
contributor_roles.description: Organisation or person contributing as a research partner.

visualisation_types.label: Beeswarm
visualisation_types.description: Horizontal or vertical dot-strip plot with points offset to avoid overlap.

visualisation_types.label: Globe
visualisation_types.description: 3D interactive globe projection, distinct from a flat 2D map.

visualisation_types.label: Bubble chart
visualisation_types.description: Scatter-style plot where a data value is also encoded as circle size.

visualisation_types.label: Tile grid map
visualisation_types.description: Grid of uniform tiles arranged to approximate geography (e.g. one tile per country/state), coloured by value, rather than a geographically accurate map.

visualisation_types.label: Alluvial diagram
visualisation_types.description: Stacked-ribbon flow diagram tracking categorical membership across discrete stages; related to but distinct from a Sankey diagram.

visualisation_types.label: Dendrogram
visualisation_types.description: Radial or linear hierarchical clustering tree; the source component's own name for this specific tree layout.

visualisation_types.label: Waffle chart
visualisation_types.description: Grid of individual unit rectangles/squares, one per data point, coloured/grouped to show proportions.

visualisation_types.label: Data physicalisation
visualisation_types.description: Genre-level: a physical, non-software artefact (e.g. a sculpture, printed object, or installation) used to represent data.

visualisation_types.label: UpSet plot
visualisation_types.description: Matrix-based visualisation of set intersections/co-occurrence, an alternative to a Venn diagram for many sets.

visualisation_types.label: Provenance tree
visualisation_types.description: Bidirectional upstream/downstream tree showing how a piece of data or process came to be, distinct from a simple hierarchical tree.

visualisation_types.label: Scrollytelling
visualisation_types.description: Genre-level: a scroll-driven narrative combining multiple chart-level views as the reader scrolls, rather than a single chart type.

visualisation_types.label: Infographic
visualisation_types.description: Genre-level: a static or lightly-interactive explainer combining charts, icons, and text on one topic, rather than a cross-filtering dashboard.

link_types.label: Public link
link_types.description: Live, public-facing page intended for general audiences to view the visualisation.

link_types.label: Embedded link
link_types.description: Standalone or iframe-embeddable link to the visualisation itself, separate from any public-facing page it may be embedded in.

link_types.label: Source code
link_types.description: Link to the code base (e.g. GitHub repository) for the visualisation.

tool_types.label: Visualisation library
tool_types.description: A library for rendering data-driven visualisations, e.g. D3, p5.

tool_types.label: Front-end framework
tool_types.description: A framework the app/UI is built on, e.g. Vue, Svelte, Streamlit.

tool_types.label: GIS tool
tool_types.description: A mapping or geospatial-analysis library, e.g. Mapbox GL, Leaflet, Turf.

tool_types.label: Hosting service
tool_types.description: A platform used to deploy/host the visualisation, e.g. Render, GitHub Pages.

tool_types.label: Commercial visualisation tool
tool_types.description: A hosted, no-code/low-code commercial platform used to build and embed the visualisation, e.g. Power BI, Kumu.
